bugs.name: Tags search treats "%" and "_" as wildcards instead of literal characters
bugs.summary: Percent and underscore are passed through to the server's LIKE pattern unescaped: "%" and "_" alone return every tag, and "agent7%tag" returns the two agent7 tags as if % were "match anything". A search for text that does not exist literally returns matching tags, so the filter cannot be used to find a tag whose name really contains % or _. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/tags)
bugs.expected: The search box filters on the literal text typed: a query containing % or _ (e.g. "agent7%tag") matches only tag names that literally contain those characters, so it should show "0 Tags" / "No results found." for these queries.
bugs.actual: Percent and underscore are passed through to the server's LIKE pattern unescaped: "%" and "_" alone return every tag, and "agent7%tag" returns the two agent7 tags as if % were "match anything". A search for text that does not exist literally returns matching tags, so the filter cannot be used to find a tag whose name really contains % or _.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-i1oztpwgvm7yuf0jcznbw.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/tags (signed in as eval). The repository has tags v1.0.0, agent7-tag-a, agent7-a-very-long-tag-name-for-layout-testing-0123456789abcdefghij, agent9-tag-msg.
In the 'Search tags...' box type a single % and press Enter (address becomes /tags?q=%25).
All 4 tags are listed even though no tag name contains a % character.
In the same box type a single _ and press Enter (/tags?q=_).
All 4 tags are listed again, although no tag name contains an underscore-only match that way.
In the same box type agent7%tag and press Enter (/tags?q=agent7%25tag).
The list shows 2 tags ('agent7-a-very-long-tag-name-for-layout-testing-0123456789abcdefghij' and 'agent7-tag-a') and the heading says '2 Tags', although no tag name contains a literal %.
